**Job Summary**
Church & Dwight is seeking an AI Engineer to join our R&D Agentic Pod team, which is responsible for designing, building, deploying, and scaling AI-powered products that transform how R&D teams make decisions and operate. The AI Engineer, R&D will specialize in large language models and generative AI, with primary accountability for building reliable retrieval-augmented generation systems, agentic workflows, orchestration, and production integrations.
  
  
**About The Role**
The AI Engineer, R&D will translate R&D business requirements into secure, scalable AI products that combine enterprise knowledge, approved data, machine learning models, tools, and human oversight. The AI Engineer builds the technical foundations that enable agents and generative AI applications to operate reliably in the enterprise.
  
  
Working closely with R&D, Quality, & Regulatory stakeholders, AI Champions, Data Scientists, GTA partners, enterprise architecture, security, data engineering, and platform teams, this role contributes from prototype through deployment, monitoring, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Success in this role will be measured by solution quality, accuracy, reliability, security, maintainability, user adoption, business impact, cost and latency performance, and delivery of reusable generative AI capabilities.
  
  
The role sits within the Global Technology and Analytics (GTA) R&D Innovation & AI organization, reporting to the Lead, R&D Agentic Pod.
  
  
**Work Environment**
Hybrid: This is a hybrid role based in Princeton, NJ, and requires in- person attendance on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with remote work options on Mondays and Fridays.
  
  
**Role Accountabilities And Responsibilities**

* Translate R&D business needs into secure, scalable AI products combining approved enterprise knowledge, structured and unstructured data, models, tools, permissions, and human oversight.
* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain LLM and generative AI applications, agentic workflows, and orchestration patterns covering planning, routing, tool use, memory, handoffs, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Build and optimize RAG systems using vector databases, embeddings, chunking, indexing, metadata, hybrid search, reranking, grounding, and source attribution; create traceable ingestion and refresh processes.
* Engineer reusable production prompts and integrations for generative AI APIs, enterprise services, applications, analytical models, workflow tools, and knowledge repositories.
